steps.name: Warm sky base

colors.name: Sunset Coral
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium red + 2 titanium white + a touch of cadmium yellow

colors.name: Flame Orange
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 cadmium red

colors.name: Sun Yellow
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

steps.tip: Cover the top part of the canvas, down to just past halfway, with Sunset Coral. Use long side-to-side strokes that curve a little, and paint straight through where the figures will go. Let the bottom edge be loose and wavy.

steps.name: Blue swirls and yellow centers

colors.name: Deep Swirl Blue
colors.recipe: 3 ultramarine blue + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Sun Yellow
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Flame Orange
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 cadmium red

steps.tip: Let the sky dry a little. Then paint a big Deep Swirl Blue spiral that starts at the upper left, curls across the top, and wraps around the yellow hook at the upper center.

steps.name: Setting sun and blue mountains

colors.name: Pale Sun
colors.recipe: 4 titanium white + 1 cadmium yellow

colors.name: Deep Swirl Blue
colors.recipe: 3 ultramarine blue + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Flame Orange
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 cadmium red

steps.tip: With the round brush, dab a half circle of Pale Sun about two-thirds of the way across, low in the orange glow.

steps.name: Green fields and hill

colors.name: Meadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 ultramarine blue + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Shadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 ultramarine blue + 2 cadmium yellow + 1 burnt sienna

colors.name: Lime Light
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium yellow + 1 meadow green + 1 titanium white

steps.tip: Fill all the white canvas below the mountains with Meadow Green. Use strokes that follow the rolling curves, rising toward the lower left to make the big hill.

steps.name: River and village houses

colors.name: River Blue
colors.recipe: 2 titanium white + 1 ultramarine blue

colors.name: Pale Sun
colors.recipe: 4 titanium white + 1 cadmium yellow

colors.name: Cream White
colors.recipe: 5 titanium white + a touch of cadmium yellow + a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Roof Red
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium red + 1 cadmium yellow

colors.name: Shadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 ultramarine blue + 2 cadmium yellow + 1 burnt sienna

steps.tip: Paint the river in River Blue. Start thin just right of center under the mountains, then curve it in an S down to the bottom right corner, getting wider as it comes closer.

steps.name: Cypress trees and villagers

colors.name: Shadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 ultramarine blue + 2 cadmium yellow + 1 burnt sienna

colors.name: Meadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 ultramarine blue + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Heart Red
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium red + 1 burnt sienna

colors.name: River Blue
colors.recipe: 2 titanium white + 1 ultramarine blue

colors.name: Deep Swirl Blue
colors.recipe: 3 ultramarine blue + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Skin Brown
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Dark Earth
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 ultramarine blue

steps.tip: Tap about ten tall, pointed cypress trees in Shadow Green with the brush corner. Put them between the houses, beside the river and on the right bank, with the nearer ones taller.

steps.name: The boy on the hill

colors.name: Cream White
colors.recipe: 5 titanium white + a touch of cadmium yellow + a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Sun Yellow
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Dark Earth
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 ultramarine blue

colors.name: Skin Brown
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Shadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 ultramarine blue + 2 cadmium yellow + 1 burnt sienna

steps.tip: On the lower left hill, block in the boy's T-shirt with Cream White using short strokes. He is seen from behind.

steps.name: The flying girl

colors.name: River Blue
colors.recipe: 2 titanium white + 1 ultramarine blue

colors.name: Cream White
colors.recipe: 5 titanium white + a touch of cadmium yellow + a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Flame Orange
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 cadmium red

colors.name: Skin Brown
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 cadmium yellow + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Dark Earth
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 ultramarine blue

steps.tip: In the upper right sky, paint the girl's dress in three bands with short strokes: River Blue on the left, Cream White in the middle, Flame Orange on the right. Let the skirt flare out to the left.

steps.name: Heart string, texture and highlights

colors.name: Heart Red
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium red + 1 burnt sienna

colors.name: Dark Earth
colors.recipe: 2 burnt sienna + 1 ultramarine blue

colors.name: Lime Light
colors.recipe: 3 cadmium yellow + 1 meadow green + 1 titanium white

colors.name: Shadow Green
colors.recipe: 2 ultramarine blue + 2 cadmium yellow + 1 burnt sienna

colors.name: Pale Sun
colors.recipe: 4 titanium white + 1 cadmium yellow

colors.name: Flame Orange
colors.recipe: 2 cadmium yellow + 1 cadmium red

steps.tip: Load the liner brush with watery Heart Red. Pull one wavy line from the boy's raised hand up to the girl's left hand.

steps.name: Sunset sky gradient

colors.name: Golden Glow
colors.recipe: 3 parts Cadmium yellow medium + 2 parts Titanium white

colors.name: Sunset Orange
colors.recipe: 3 parts Cadmium yellow medium + 1 part Cadmium red medium + 1 part Titanium white

colors.name: Dusk Lavender
colors.recipe: 4 parts Titanium white + 2 parts Ultramarine blue + 1 part Cadmium red medium

steps.tip: With a large flat brush, fill the upper center (where the sun will go, about 40% across and 30% down) with Golden Glow using X strokes.

steps.name: Cloud streaks

colors.name: Ember Red
colors.recipe: 2 parts Cadmium red medium + 1 part Cadmium yellow medium + 1 part Titanium white

colors.name: Sunset Orange
colors.recipe: 3 parts Cadmium yellow medium + 1 part Cadmium red medium + 1 part Titanium white

colors.name: Dusk Lavender
colors.recipe: 4 parts Titanium white + 2 parts Ultramarine blue + 1 part Cadmium red medium

colors.name: Twilight Blue
colors.recipe: 2 parts Ultramarine blue + 1 part Titanium white + a touch of Cadmium red medium

steps.tip: With a medium flat brush, lay Ember Red cloud streaks across the upper half in short horizontal strokes, with a strong band in the top left and more around the upper right.

steps.name: Sun and glow

colors.name: Sun White
colors.recipe: 6 parts Titanium white + 1 part Cadmium yellow medium

colors.name: Golden Glow
colors.recipe: 3 parts Cadmium yellow medium + 2 parts Titanium white

steps.tip: With a medium round brush, paint a round Sun White disc in the golden area, about 40% across and 30% down, using circular strokes.

steps.name: Big trunks

colors.name: Silhouette Brown
colors.recipe: 2 parts Burnt sienna + 1 part Ultramarine blue

steps.tip: With a medium flat brush, pull five trunks up from the bottom edge to the top: far left, a wide one left of the sun (about 30% across), a leaning one right of the sun that splits upward into a Y, a slender one at about 80% across, and a thick one along the right edge.

steps.name: Main branches

colors.name: Silhouette Brown
colors.recipe: 2 parts Burnt sienna + 1 part Ultramarine blue

steps.tip: With a small round brush, pull a big branch from the center trunk sweeping up to the right toward the top, pressing at the trunk then lifting.

steps.name: Bark texture and shadows

colors.name: Night Bark
colors.recipe: 1 part Burnt sienna + 2 parts Ultramarine blue

steps.tip: With an old stiff brush, dry brush Night Bark in light vertical strokes down the trunks and thick branches for bark texture.

steps.name: Rim light and final highlights

colors.name: Warm Rim
colors.recipe: 2 parts Burnt sienna + 1 part Cadmium red medium + 1 part Cadmium yellow medium

colors.name: Sun White
colors.recipe: 6 parts Titanium white + 1 part Cadmium yellow medium

colors.name: Golden Glow
colors.recipe: 3 parts Cadmium yellow medium + 2 parts Titanium white

steps.tip: Dry brush Warm Rim along the trunk edges facing the sun, mostly the right edge of the wide center-left trunk and the left edge of the leaning trunk.

steps.name: Night sky with aurora

colors.name: Midnight Blue
colors.recipe: 3 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part titanium white, a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Aurora Green
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part ultramarine blue, 2 parts titanium white

steps.tip: With the large flat brush, cover the top third of the canvas with Midnight Blue using long side-to-side strokes. Go a little below where the mountain peaks will sit.

steps.name: Moon glow and starburst

colors.name: Moon Glow
colors.recipe: 4 parts titanium white, a touch of cadmium yellow

colors.name: Aurora Green
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part ultramarine blue, 2 parts titanium white

steps.tip: Let the sky dry. Then dry brush a soft halo of Moon Glow on the aurora, just left of center in the upper sky.

steps.name: Snowy mountains

colors.name: Snow Blue
colors.recipe: 5 parts titanium white, 1 part ultramarine blue

colors.name: Shadow Navy
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part burnt sienna, 1 part titanium white

colors.name: Midnight Blue
colors.recipe: 3 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part titanium white, a touch of burnt sienna

steps.tip: Sketch a jagged peak line across the canvas just below the moon. Put tall peaks at the left and right and a deep V-dip in the center, under the aurora.

steps.name: Dark pine tree line

colors.name: Shadow Navy
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part burnt sienna, 1 part titanium white

colors.name: Midnight Blue
colors.recipe: 3 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part titanium white, a touch of burnt sienna

steps.tip: With the stiff brush, tap a dark band of Shadow Navy across the base of the mountains.

steps.name: Snowy fields and road base

colors.name: Snow Blue
colors.recipe: 5 parts titanium white, 1 part ultramarine blue

colors.name: Pure White
colors.recipe: Titanium white straight from the tube

steps.tip: Mark a vanishing point at the center of the tree line. Draw the two road edges spreading out from it to the bottom corners.

steps.name: Tire tracks

colors.name: Track Slate
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part burnt sienna, 3 parts titanium white

colors.name: Shadow Navy
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part burnt sienna, 1 part titanium white

steps.tip: With the medium flat brush, paint two wide dark Track Slate lanes and a broken center strip. Make them wide at the bottom and narrow to a thin line at the vanishing point.

steps.name: Shrubs and bare trees

colors.name: Twig Brown
colors.recipe: 2 parts burnt sienna, 1 part ultramarine blue, a touch of cadmium red

colors.name: Shadow Navy
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part burnt sienna, 1 part titanium white

steps.tip: With the stiff brush, tap low rounded Twig Brown shrub clumps along both sides of the road, just below the tree line. Add a few more scattered in the fields.

steps.name: Final highlights

colors.name: Pure White
colors.recipe: Titanium white straight from the tube

colors.name: Moon Glow
colors.recipe: 4 parts titanium white, a touch of cadmium yellow

steps.tip: Dry brush Pure White along the lit edges of the peaks and the snowbanks beside the road.

steps.name: Green background

colors.name: Grass Green
colors.recipe: 3 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part ultramarine blue, a touch of white

colors.name: Deep Grass
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part ultramarine blue, a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Sunny Lime
colors.recipe: 3 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part grass green, 1 part white

steps.tip: Cover the whole canvas with Grass Green using a large flat brush and short criss-cross X strokes, painting straight through the middle where the cream and marshmallows will go.

steps.name: Cream swirl shape

colors.name: Sky Swirl
colors.recipe: 4 parts white, 1 part ultramarine blue

steps.tip: With a medium flat brush and Sky Swirl, outline a big mound in the center: a pointed tip near the top middle, widening into bumpy rounded lobes on both sides and along the bottom.

steps.name: Cream swirl stripes

colors.name: Cream Blue
colors.recipe: 2 parts ultramarine blue, 1 part white

colors.name: Frosting White
colors.recipe: White with a tiny touch of ultramarine blue

colors.name: Sky Swirl
colors.recipe: 4 parts white, 1 part ultramarine blue

steps.tip: Paint curved Cream Blue bands that spiral from the top tip down and around the mound, curling in toward a center point just right of the middle.

steps.name: Marshmallows and shadows

colors.name: Marshmallow Cream
colors.recipe: 5 parts white, 1 small part cadmium yellow

colors.name: Marshmallow Shade
colors.recipe: 3 parts marshmallow cream, 1 small part cadmium yellow, a touch of burnt sienna

colors.name: Deep Grass
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium yellow, 1 part ultramarine blue, a touch of burnt sienna

steps.tip: Mark eleven marshmallow spots in an arc around the swirl: five on the left, two above the top left, and four on the right.

steps.name: Cat body

colors.name: Kitty Coral
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium red, 1 part white, a touch of cadmium yellow

steps.tip: With a medium round brush and Kitty Coral, paint a big rounded body shape across the middle of the swirl, its back curving to the right.

steps.name: Cat shading and fur

colors.name: Kitty Shadow
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium red, 1 part burnt sienna

colors.name: Kitty Coral
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium red, 1 part white, a touch of cadmium yellow

steps.tip: With a small round brush, pull Kitty Shadow along the bottom of the body, under the head and along the underside of the tail.

steps.name: Face and highlights

colors.name: Kitty Glow
colors.recipe: 2 parts kitty coral, 1 part white

colors.name: Kitty Shadow
colors.recipe: 2 parts cadmium red, 1 part burnt sienna

colors.name: Frosting White
colors.recipe: White with a tiny touch of ultramarine blue

steps.tip: Dry brush Kitty Glow highlights on top of the head, the ears' outer edges, the back and the top of the tail.
